notes: Flat 4.95% on net income (35 ILCS 5/201). 2026 exemption allowance is $2,925 per person (2026 Booklet IL-700-T; IL-1040-ES 2026 worksheet multiplies net income by 4.95%).

No exemption is allowed if federal AGI exceeds $250,000 ($500,000 MFJ) (35 ILCS 5/204; Form IL-W-4). Modeled as a cliff via personalExemptionPhaseout; the related $1,000 age 65+/blind allowances are not modeled.
Illinois has no standard deduction. Not modeled: dependent exemptions, Illinois additions/subtractions (e.g., retirement income subtraction), property tax, education, EITC and other credits.

seDeduction.note: Inherited: Illinois base income starts from federal AGI.

retirementContributions.note: SEP-IRA and solo 401(k) deductions are inherited through federal AGI.

qbi.note: The federal QBI deduction is below AGI and does not enter Illinois base income.

localIncomeTax.note: No Illinois city or county (including Chicago) levies a local income tax.

estimatedTax.threshold: Required if you reasonably expect 2026 Illinois tax liability to exceed $1,000 after withholding, pass-through withholding and allowed credits.
estimatedTax.safeHarbor: No late-payment penalty if you pay at least 90% of this year's tax or at least 100% of last year's tax in four equal timely installments (IL-1040-ES); annualize on IL-2210 if income is uneven.

businessCosts.annualReportFee: $75 annual report (yearly), plus penalty if delinquent.
businessCosts.franchiseOrMinimumTax: None for an LLC (Illinois franchise tax applies to corporations). Personal Property Replacement Tax (1.5% for partnerships/S corps, 2.5% for corporations) does not apply to a sole proprietor or a disregarded single-member LLC.
businessCosts.grossReceiptsTax: None at the state level for professional services.
